minutes.title: Functional Design Meeting Minutes
minutes.summary: The meeting discussed the design of a new remote control, focusing on minimizing buttons and incorporating voice-activated controls. Decisions were made to use a joystick for channel navigation and menu selection, with additional considerations for user interface and locating features.
decisions: We should go with a small joystick for changing channels up and down, and one more button for menu navigation.

actions.task: Create a user interface based on the discussed principles
Investigate feasibility of voice-activated control and research industrial designer's opinion
Decide on the design of the remote control
Explore options for a clapping or digital telephone-based location system
Consider incorporating an LED for locating purposes
